conclusions.text: All 48 component identities, current physical features, route component rows and route admin-binding rows restore without missing IDs or canonical feature/geometry hash mismatches; all eight positive-length contacts are present.

The retained simplified products have 339 Mongolia features and 2,327 Russia features against 2,328 advertised; positive-area geometric overlay occurs for 33 Mongolia and 34 Russia target components, with all 48 target IDs retained in both tables.

The independently captured NSO response contains 339 features and has positive-area geometric overlay for 37 of the 48 components; layer legal effectiveness, accuracy, lineage and reuse terms remain unresolved.

No reviewed source resolves legal administrative assignment, physical land/water status, ownership, or component-level cause for any target; authoritative Mongolian boundary/hydrology payloads and current Buryatia polygons/legal instruments remain required.
